A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research work and contain complete, readable main text and Appendices A–D. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison support a reliable comparison of their scientific and visual content.

before.justification: v2 reports original linear-regression simulations, MNIST CVAE experiments and SmolLM2-135M summarization experiments on XSUM, including supplementary results in Appendices C–D.

after.justification: v3 retains the original linear-regression, MNIST CVAE and XSUM summarization results, including the supplementary experiments in Appendices C–D.

M1.justification: The proposed generate–verify–retrain algorithms, verifier rule, model architectures and losses are unchanged. Appendix C revises the reported CVAE experimental data composition without establishing a change to the proposed method itself.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same simulated regression tasks, MNIST image generation and XSUM summarization, including the same appendix scenarios. The CVAE data-mixing revision concerns the protocol within retained MNIST coverage.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged, including unfiltered retraining, initial real-data estimators and the CVAE trained on all 60K real images. No comparison method is added or removed.

E3.justification: Appendix C changes the stated CVAE retraining data from filtered synthetic samples combined with the real dataset in v2 to the filtered synthetic samples themselves in v3. Removing real-data reuse changes a central experimental control for studying model collapse. This is a substantial reported protocol revision, although the PDFs do not establish whether experiments were rerun or the description was corrected.

E4.justification: The verifier-quality and sample-size analyses, random-covariate experiments, alternative verifier shapes, MNIST-specific FID evaluation and initial-data-size ablations are unchanged.

E5.justification: There are no changes to repeated-run or seed information, uncertainty reporting or statistical tests. The experimental plots retain identical reporting.

E6.justification: All reported numerical and qualitative results are unchanged. For example, both versions report FID 21.17 for the best synthetic CVAE and 17.56 for the 60K-real-image baseline. The revised protocol description is not accompanied by replacement results or evidence of a performance change.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, assumptions, Theorems 3.1 and 4.1, Gaussian toolkit and proofs in Appendices A–B, and verifier-shape derivations in Appendix D.2 are identical.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and discussion retain the same claims about near-term improvement, the verifier-induced bias–variance trade-off and long-term convergence to the verifier’s knowledge center.

C2.justification: Interpretations and limitations remain unchanged, including explanations involving verifier bias, restricted diversity, perceptual quality versus likelihood, and the limits of extending linear-regression theory to richer models.

D1.justification: Appendix C revises the instruction for assembling each CVAE retraining dataset by removing the real-data mixing step. Other implementation details, hyperparameters and code-access information are unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are unchanged, including comparisons with real/synthetic data mixing, filtering approaches and reward-maximization frameworks.

P1.justification: One sentence in Appendix C is shortened to revise the retraining-data description, and the arXiv version/date stamp is updated. The remaining prose, terminology and document structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–10, captions, algorithm displays and their placement are unchanged. Rendered differences are confined to the revised sentence and arXiv stamp, with no figure, table or structural layout revision.

improvement.justification: Replacing v2’s real-data mixing instruction makes Appendix C more consistent with the synthetic-only retraining framework described in Section 2 and Scheme 2, improving internal consistency and clarity for reproduction. This is a limited reporting improvement: the theory and results are unchanged, and the PDFs do not establish whether the edit corrects documentation or reflects changed experimental execution.
